correctness.rationale: The five-query upper bound uses four versus eight common centers for a pair sharing exactly one symbol, and the maximal four-member top versus five-member two-symbol star dichotomy. For four queries the incidence-vector complete isomorphism invariant yields 66 types, of which exactly one has every trace on fifteen ambient symbols; the 12+3 stabilization proves this is valid at every order. The seven-symbol witness, unique-center count, and n=3..6 boundaries are explicit. The standard-library certificate has been executed successfully; finite computation is used only for the finite lemma, not as a replacement for stabilization or the universal five-support argument.
